message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 7.1.0 Official Public Release Notes
This major release introduces two massive new creative workspaces—Graph Editor 2.0 and Map Rigs—alongside high-speed downloader upgrades, vector tools restoration, and persistent local asset rendering.

♦️ Graph Editor 2.0 Workspace
* Custom Easing Engine: Integrated a complete custom-easing curve editor built directly into Flex featuring 6 distinct curve models (Bezier, Spline, Elastic, Bounce, Wave, and Steps).
* Easing Preset Directory: Appended an expansive preset library covering Ease, Ease In/Out, Sharp, Spring, Rubber, Gravity, Elastic, Expo, Quint, Circ, Back, Sine, Quad, Cubic, and Timeremap curve profiles.
* Dynamic Curve Presets: Implemented custom curve saving parameters across DEF, BASE, and MINE layout tabs to build, store, and reuse easing curves across projects.
* Live AE Synchronization: Integrated real-time playhead marker tracking and auto-apply curve updating to observe timeline animation changes live while tweaking graph controls.
* Curve Expression Exporter: Added full copy/paste curve expression support to easily convert and share custom easing math with team members.
* High-Precision Node Sliders: Added X1, Y1, X2, and Y2 numeric sliders to dial in exact coordinate handle readouts alongside flexible layout column controls.

♦️ Map Rigs Workspace
* Universal Global Search: Search and locate any country, state, city, neighborhood, road, landmark, or point of interest worldwide with live OpenStreetMap suggestions.
* Vector Trace & Pin Tracking: Instantly convert real geographic boundaries into editable native AE shape layers with fill/stroke parameters, and pin target tracker points to follow map moves.
* Camera Fly-Through Suite: Set, update, and clear spatial camera keyframes with per-keyframe bearing banking, real-time preview scrubbing, timeline play controls, and native keyframe baking.
* 3D Terrain & Basemaps: Toggle between 4 distinct basemap styles (Satellite, Street, Dark, Light) with high-res zoom controls, 4-tier Terrain Relief elevation shading, and Ctrl-drag/Alt-drag controls for true 3D terrain imports into Advanced 3D, Cinema 4D, or Classic 3D workspaces.

♦️ Online Downloader Upgrades
* Adaptive Resolution Unlocking: Added dynamic 2K and 4K download options that unlock exclusively when supported by the source media URL.
* Hardware-Accelerated Conversion: Upgraded backend encoding pipeline to leverage GPU-accelerated processing for dramatically faster conversion times on high-resolution clips.
* Interface Refresh: Updated the downloader workspace layout to match modern macOS-style visual guidelines.

♦️ Background Remover & Vector Fixes
* Persistent Local Media Archiving: Resolved system Temp folder purge issues by redirecting cut-out background assets to write directly into a persistent local project directory.
* Layer Selection Validation: Cleared false 'Select a layer first' error prompts that triggered despite active timeline layer selections.
* Parametric Vector Shapes Patch: Restored shape generator algorithms to ensure Star and Hexagon vector tools render native geometry correctly inside active compositions.
